## Checklist

- [ ] A test that failed before this change and passes now (for any change to logic)
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] No real emails, names or account data in tests, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Works on macOS, Windows and Linux, or the part that doesn't is guarded
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), as the [DCO](../DCO) asks
